credits.title: The Gospel of Christmas
credits.overview: A struggling pastor moves his family to a troubled New York neighborhood, where they must save a neglected church from foreclosure before Christmas.

credits.title: Unsinkable: The Secret to Bouncing Back
credits.overview: Bestselling author of "Unsinkable" and renowned “Bounce Back” expert, Sonia Ricotti, explores the true secret to bouncing back quickly when life knocks you down.  This transformational film, will take you through one of the most inspirational and life-changing journeys of your life.  Get ready to be unsinkable!
